content:
Jordan C: Just received invoice INV-2026-909 from EdgeNimbus for $55,600. No PO on header and vendor name shown as 'Edge Nimbus LLC'. PDF: https://s3.company/edgenimbus/INV-2026-909.pdf
Priya M: Coupa lookup: we have PO 128812 for EdgeNimbus but it's under 'EdgeNimbus, Inc' and currently APPROVED for $50k. Remaining budget = $0 (commit exhausted).
Ellen R: Looks like invoice includes $5,600 of post-commit overage + $50k final milestone. If PO is for $50k and commit consumed, vendor should reference PO but still bill overage separately.
ProcurementBot: PO 128812 status: APPROVED. Original PO amount: $50,000. Remaining budget: -$0. Suggested action: request vendor reissue separating PO-covered line and overage, or provide written confirmation mapping invoice to PO 128812.
Jordan C: Business sponsor says milestone work completed and they'd like to pay the $50k portion ASAP. Overages need project approval. What approval path do we use for split invoice?
Priya M: Finance policy: split lines allowed if vendor reissues with PO# on the PO-covered line. For the overage ($5.6k) route to project manager for expense approval. Director approval required only if single invoice >$50k. This one equals $55.6k so Director sign-off needed for total if paid as single invoice.
Ellen R: So preferred: vendor reissue two invoices: (A) $50k with PO 128812 on header, (B) $5,600 separate overage invoice referencing contract SOW. That avoids Director escalation. I'll ask vendor to reissue.
Jordan C: Can invoices-bot do a tentative split in NetSuite if vendor delays? We sometimes do one-off coding but still need written vendor confirmation.
invoices-bot: New invoice INV-2026-909 logged (NS-INV-19988). Status: "On Hold - PO Missing". Action: hold payment, notify finance-approvers. Note: auto-split not permitted without vendor confirmation.
Priya M: I'll email vendor: "Please reissue INV-2026-909 as two documents: invoice A for $50,000 referencing PO 128812 on the header; invoice B for $5,600 documenting overage details. If you cannot reissue, please provide a signed statement tying the $50k to PO 128812 and line-level breakdown."
Jordan C: Business asks if we can pre-approve the $50k now to avoid service delays. Procurement, can you confirm PO mapping so finance can provisionally code?
ProcurementBot: Confirmation: PO 128812 covers the milestone and aligns to $50k. Procurement can provide written confirmation to finance if vendor cannot reissue. Suggest procurement email: "We confirm invoice INV-2026-909 contains a $50,000 line that maps to PO 128812."
Ellen R: If procurement provides that email and vendor signs off, finance can match and route the $50k for payment without vendor reissue. We still require separate approval for the $5.6k overage from the project lead.
Dana (CFO): Quick note: I approve a one-time Director exception only if procurement confirms mapping and vendor provides a signed confirmation (reissue preferred). Otherwise route full invoice to me for review.
Jordan C: Vendor replied: "We will reissue two invoices within 24 hours and include PO 128812 on the $50k invoice. Apologies for the confusion"
Priya M: Great. Please CC finance@redwood on the reissued invoices. Marking this thread pending reissue; will route $50k to payment once posted.
Ellen R: I'll prepare GL coding: $50k to GL 6100 (Capitalized implementation) and $5.6k to GL 6540 (SaaS overage).
Jordan C: Thanks all. Leaving thread open until reissued invoices are attached.
